name: 技能検定の成績証明書に手数料を新設
summary: 技能検定成績証明書の交付に、新たな手数料を設けます。令和8年4月16日以降に交付申請書を受理したものから適用します。
changes: 技能検定成績証明書の交付手数料を新設する
who: 技能検定成績証明書の交付を申請する人
why: 出入国管理及び難民認定法施行規則などの改正省令の施行に伴い、手数料を新設するためと、県は説明しています。

en.name: Introduces a fee for skill test results certificates
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance Implementing the Act on the Promotion of Human Resources Development
en.summary: A new fee will be charged for issuing skill test results certificates. It will apply to applications for issuance received on or after April 16, 2026.
changes: Introduces a fee for issuing skill test results certificates
who: People applying for a skill test results certificate
en.why: The prefecture says it is introducing the fee in connection with the enforcement of amended ministerial ordinances, including the Ordinance for Enforcement of the Immigration Control and Refugee Recognition Act.
